property_summary: For any call to fallback that satisfies the preconditions (msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), the reference contract always updates pastBlockTime to old block.timestamp + 1; the mutant that omits the assignment can leave pastBlockTime unchanged for some inputs, violating this property.
change_summary: Delete the assignment to pastBlockTime so the state variable is unchanged by the fallback call.
